Name: DOSe LED Control
Description: Control your RGB LED strip/lamp over Bluetooth from the D200H: color keys, power, brightness and a settings key with BLE scanning.

Actions.Name: Color
Actions.Tooltip: Apply a color to the light. Hold the key to cycle the palette.

Actions.Name: Power
Actions.Tooltip: Turn the light on or off.

Actions.Name: Brightness
Actions.Tooltip: Set, step or cycle the brightness.

Actions.Name: Settings & Status
Actions.Tooltip: MAC address, BLE scan, palette and connection status. Press to reconnect; hold to restart the bridge.
